pcs.pc_description: remove the packaging of the appliance delivered at the customer location
verify that the product matches the customer's order with all supporting accessories
check the availability of all tools and fitments for the installation
clear up the packaging material waste and dispose as per company’s norms

modules.module_title: Install the TV and check functionality

pcs.pc_description: seek customer's input of placement of TV
measure length from the floor and the sides of the wall for drilling holes (if applicable)
attach mounting brackets at the back side of the TV in case of wall mounting
insert anchors into drilled holes, concealing necessary wires and connect from the nearest power supply
install the TV unit on appropriate stand/platform/wall mount while maintaining appropriate distance from the floor and walls as per instruction manual
plug in the power supply and demonstrate the features, utility of the TV set/remote control
educate customer on proper operation, precautions and maintenance procedures to be taken
diagnose the fault in the unit as per customer interaction and initial inspection like power supply module etc.
ensure that the fault is internal before disassembling the unit
unplug the power supply and any other equipment, if connected
remove the TV from the wall
remove the screws attached to the mounts and separate the rear cover from the system
examine various modules to locate exact fault
discharge any large capacitor and the charge stored in the cathode ray tube before diagnosis
check the fuse to ensure that the capacitor has not blown off and follow the current path to identify the fault
interpret instructions manual accurately to correlate the symptoms indicated with exact problem
send to factory for in depth diagnosis, if problem cannot be identified at site
repair/replace the internal components (e.g., screens, circuits, power boards). component at location, if the fault identified is due to damage of parts like fuse, PCBs etc..
schedule next appointment if the parts like picture tube can't be replaced on site
make necessary arrangements if the TV is required to be transported to service centre
reassemble the unit to check that all the modules of the unit are working as per specifications

modules.module_title: Confirm functionality of the repaired unit

pcs.pc_description: demonstrate functionality of the unit to the customer
provide information to the customer about cleaning procedures and precautions to be taken in order to avoid recurrence of problem
complete all documentation procedures for complaint closure
collect necessary payments from the customer
